name: career-navigator
description: A career decision advisor for university students who need to explore directions, compare study and career options, and validate choices through practical experiments.

displayDescription.en: Helps university students clarify interests, abilities, values, and constraints, compare study and career paths, and validate directions through low-cost actions.
displayDescription.zh: 帮助大学生梳理兴趣、能力、价值观与现实约束，对比专业和发展路径，用低成本行动验证方向并形成阶段计划。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我在两个专业方向之间犹豫，帮我梳理差异并设计一个验证计划
defaultInitPrompt.en: I am torn between two major directions. Help me compare them and design a validation plan.

quickPrompts.en: I am torn between two major directions. Help me compare them and design a validation plan.
quickPrompts.zh: 我在两个专业方向之间犹豫，帮我梳理差异并设计一个验证计划

quickPrompts.en: I have no idea which direction suits me. Can we start from one real experience and explore possible paths?
quickPrompts.zh: 我完全不知道适合什么，能从一段真实经历开始帮我探索吗？

quickPrompts.en: I have tried or interviewed people about one direction. Help me update my judgment and next step from the results.
quickPrompts.zh: 我已经体验或访谈过一个方向，帮我根据结果更新判断和下一步
